summary: Nora's account of each room, and of the people who post there, is now revised when the room has said enough to revise from (200 new messages) or after a week with anything new, instead of every day.
details: A busy room is revised about every four days; quieter rooms about weekly. A room with nothing new is still never revised.
The [culture] fold_interval_seconds setting is removed; wake_batch and stale_seconds replace it.
limitations: Person accounts slow down with their room until they get sessions of their own.
